name: Ruul Snowhoof
summary: At Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale, Ruul Snowhoof waits for rescue. Trapped in bear form, the tauren druid depends on Horde allies to free him and guide him to safety.

sections.title: A Bear in a Cage
sections.body:
Ruul Snowhoof came to northern Ashenvale and fell into the hands of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. He took bear form, and they mistook him for a wild beast. So they locked him in a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold instead of killing him.

Weakened now, Ruul cannot safely leave his form or fight his way out alone. He waits for Horde allies to open the cage, drive off his captors, and clear a path through the den. He hopes to return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why is Ruul Snowhoof a bear in a cage?
faq.answer: Ruul Snowhoof took Bear Form when the Thistlefur furbolgs confronted him. Mistaking the tauren druid for a wild beast, they locked him in a cage deep inside their hold.

faq.q: Why don't the furbolgs just kill Ruul?
aliases: what do furbolgs want with ruul
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs keep Ruul captive in bear form and let him slowly starve in his cage. The reason for this choice is not known.

faq.q: Where does Ruul go after escaping Thistlefur Hold?
faq.answer: After escaping Thistlefur Hold, Ruul asks his rescuers to tell his sister, Yama Snowhoof, that he survived. She is at Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Ruul Snowhoof?
faq.answer: No. Ruul Snowhoof is loyal to the Horde and offers help escaping only to Horde adventurers who find his cage.

angles.text: As a druid, you find Ruul caged in bear form, a sign of the taint spreading through Ashenvale's wildlife and furbolg tribes.
As a tauren, you bring a member of the Snowhoof family back alive to his sister Yama at Splintertree Post when you rescue Ruul Snowhoof.
